title: Liquor scam: Supreme Court refuses to cancel Chaitanya Baghel's bail but deletes HC comments against ED
description: The Supreme Court on Wednesday refused to cancel the bail granted to Chaitanya Baghel, son of former Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Bhupesh Baghel, in the ₹2,000-crore Chhattisgarh liquor scam case.However, a Bench of Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana expunged certain adverse remarks made by the Chhattisgarh High Court against the prosecution in its January 2026 bail order.
